project.name: osgi/domains/doctor/doctor-contract
project.description: The doctor domain's contract: its data vocabulary (the diagnostic DAG — Symptom, Observation, Assessment, Prescription, MedicalRecord, Consultation, …) AND the two consumer-side service interfaces a consulting domain resolves from the registry (ConsultingService, HealthSystem). type=contract — installed and wired bundle-to-bundle, NOT a seam (the host must never consult the doctor). It carries no @Component and does not Require the SCR extender, so a scion that needs only the interface imports this, not doctor-core (whose DefaultHealthSystem @Component pulls SCR). The live impl is in doctor-core; a test mocks via registerService. Fuses the dissolved doctor-port seam and the former doctor-records bundle (a record bundle is a contract with no interface).
